description:
Generate a shadow and elevation system tinted by the palette: elevation levels, a focus ring and a glow.

shadow_intensity: flat (borders, no depth), subtle (the default), pronounced, dramatic.

color.description: Brand color in hex (e.g. #6366F1). The whole system is built from it.

color_scheme.description: The palette the shadows are tinted from (default analogous)

colors.description: Additional brand colors in hex (up to 5 colors in total, including `color`).

preferences.description: Other design preferences, so tools called separately stay consistent with each other. Pass the same values to every tool.

color_scheme.description: How the palette is derived (default analogous)

shadow_intensity.description: How strong the elevation shadows are (default subtle)

name: chord_generate_shadows
